description: This file contains Go code for testing compatibility of Kubernetes API objects across different versions. It includes a test function 'TestCompatibility' that decodes, validates, re-encodes, and verifies JSON keys in Kubernetes objects, along with helper functions for JSON value extraction.

methods.name: TestCompatibility
methods.description: Performs decoding, validation, re-encoding, and JSON key verification on Kubernetes objects for compatibility testing.

methods.name: getJSONValue
methods.description: Helper function to extract nested JSON values, supporting array indexing.
